name: tools-figma-downloader
description: Download a Figma file of any size (sm/md/large/xl/xxxxl) in chunks — skeleton-first, bounded-concurrency batched /nodes streamed to disk, byte/time-aware re-chunking, content-hash idempotent parts, typed errors, proxy/TLS config — and reconstruct a single full file JSON locally. Zero-dependency Node ESM (Node >= 20 built-ins only). Twin of figma-downloader-py.

scripts.typecheck: node --check bin/figma-download.mjs && node --check src/cli.mjs && node --check src/figmaClient.mjs && node --check src/chunk.mjs && node --check src/reconstruct.mjs && node --check src/util.mjs && node --check src/httpFetch.mjs && node --check src/mock.mjs && node --check src/sizing.mjs && node --check src/config.mjs && node --check src/errors.mjs
